exposure: intrapartum total fetal reperfusion time (fetal resilience)
cohort: The study included 120 infants with arterial acidemia and 258 in the control group, selected from a cohort of 5694 pregnant women.
finding: Total reperfusion time (fetal resilience) and total deceleration area are non-ACOG parameters with a good predictive ability for neonatal acidemia, superior to the ACOG III classification.
